children: Known mostly for buying Magnificent Seven stocks, Fields has spent millions on stocks over the past two years.

The congressman has made 237 trades totaling $22.8 million, according to data from Quiver Quantitative. That total includes $21.58 million in trades in 2025 and more than $1 million in trades made in 2026.
After making large purchases in 2025, most of the recent transactions from Fields have been in the smaller $1,000 to $15,000 range.
